privacy.headline: Your information deserves a clear path.
body: DRAFT NOTICE — business and legal review required before publication.

This staging preview does not accept or send inquiries. When a verified recipient and safe configuration are approved, the contact form will use the RS WebFactory lead endpoint for validation, rate limiting, duplicate handling, and storage.
No payment, customer lookup, automatic email, or AI assistant is enabled for this customer preview.

Hosting may process technical information required to serve and protect the website. The business must confirm its final data controller details, retention period, service providers, and privacy contact before launch.
